name: Coldplay Kiss Cam Generator
blurb: One photo of you two in: the stadium screen finds you mid-hug, and you both dive out of the shot.

prompts.label: Coldplay kiss cam generator â the stadium dive
prompts.text: Use the photo: the two people in it are the couple; keep both faces, hair, skin tones, builds and outfits exactly as photographed (if two photos are given, one person from each). A stadium concert at night, filmed on a phone from the crowd, vertical 9:16, handheld. A rig of bright bulb lights hangs above a giant circular screen showing the kiss cam: the couple at the railing of a box seat. (1) One stands behind the other with both arms wrapped around them, both smiling and swaying to the music. (2) They catch sight of themselves on the screen: the one behind drops straight down out of sight below the railing, the one in front turns their back to the camera and walks a step away. (3) The camera stays on the empty railing and the turned back while hands in the crowd wave and people laugh. Audio: crowd roar, a soft original live ballad with no recognisable song, a loud 'ooooh'. No text, no band, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: Coldplay kiss cam generator â the arena face-palm
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep both people exactly as photographed, same faces, hair, skin tones and outfits (if two photos are given, one person from each). An indoor arena concert, filmed on a phone from the floor, vertical 9:16, pink and red stage light, a crowd silhouetted in the foreground. The giant oval screen shows the kiss cam on a row of fans in black T-shirts: the two people from the photo stand side by side among friends. (1) The camera lands on them; the one on the right freezes, then buries their face in both hands and bends forward. (2) The one on the left grins straight at the camera, puts a hand to the side of their head and flips imaginary hair, loving it. (3) A friend behind them throws a fist in the air and cheers while the screen keeps them in frame. Audio: arena crowd screaming and laughing, a booming original pop beat with no recognisable song. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: Coldplay kiss cam generator â the restaurant big screen
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep both people exactly as photographed, same faces, hair, skin tones and outfits (if two photos are given, one person from each). A busy family restaurant in daytime with long tables, string flags and a big screen on the wall, filmed on a phone from a table, vertical 9:16, handheld. The big screen plays a live kiss cam with a heart-shaped frame. (1) The screen cuts to the two people from the photo sitting at a table among the other diners, both laughing at something. (2) They look up, see themselves on the screen, and one slides down in the chair to hide behind a menu while the other points at a stranger at the next table as if to say 'not us'. (3) Kids at the nearby tables laugh and point at the screen. Audio: restaurant chatter, cutlery, a cheerful original jingle from the speakers, laughter. No text, no readable signs, no logos, no brand names, no watermark.
